title: Metro Manila Weekly Pump Prices (2017-now)
subtitle: DOE weekly retail fuel prices by city, brand and product, from PDFs to tables
description:
Weekly retail pump prices at Metro Manila (NCR) gas stations, **January 2017 to now**, by city, brand and product (about 95,000 rows).

The Philippine Department of Energy (DOE) checks pump prices every week but publishes them only as PDFs, in three different layouts since 2017. This dataset is built by [krudo](https://github.com/OrcaDS/krudo), an open-source pipeline that reads every report, cleans it with dbt, and republishes it weekly.

## Files

Each table comes as CSV and Parquet (same content).

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `fct_pump_prices` | One row per week x city x brand x product: low and high price |
| `fct_ncr_summary` | One row per week x city x product: overall range and DOE's common price |
| `dim_city`, `dim_brand`, `dim_product` | Lookup tables |
| `data_dictionary.md` | Every column explained, coverage and known gaps |

## Good to know

- Prices are Philippine pesos per litre.
- An empty price means DOE printed no price. It never means zero.
- 2017 to Sep 2019 is metro-wide (`geo_level = metro`); from Jun 2019 prices are per city.
- DOE typos are kept as printed and flagged (`is_low_above_high`, `is_out_of_bounds`), not fixed or dropped.

## Source and license

Department of Energy, Oil Industry Management Bureau, NCR price monitoring. Cleaned and standardized by krudo; not an official DOE product. Philippine government work has no copyright (RA 8293 sec. 176), so the data is public domain. Provided as is, without warranty.
